Dana (CSM): Quick heads-up: Stratus dedicated bring-up Wed 09:30 PT. Customer target steady 600 RPS with brief business spikes to 2k for ~30s. Need final quota check, autoscale policy, KV priming plan, and a 20-min ops handoff. Renewal flagged if onboarding has issues.

Marco (SRE): Copy. Contract shows 10 reserved GPUs, burst allowance +15% if capacity spare. I'll request a 12h slot-lock post-cutover and add a soft-throttle at 78% GPU mem. Send token histogram.

Dana (CSM): Quick sample: p50=66 tokens, p95=215, avg request ~330 tokens. CSV uploaded to the workspace.

Yuki (Infra Eng): With p95~215 set slot_max_seq=512, min_slots=4, scale_step=2, cooldown=90s. Fallback to quantized-lite on sustained latency >600ms for 3 windows. Avoid KMS rotates during warmup. Pre-warm KV cache ~30m before using small priming job: `python prime.py --endpoint /prime --slots 8 --concurrency 40 --duration 1800`.

Arjun (Solutions Eng): Load plan: smoke 10m @100RPS, soak 2h @600RPS, spike script: 30s ramp ->2k, hold 30s, decay 40s. Run loadgen with token tracing: `./loadgen --url https://dedicated-us.redwood/api/generate --concurrency 200 --qps 600 --burst 2000 --burst-duration 30 --duration 7200 --header 'x-customer-id:STRATUS'`. Collect traces and KV hit metrics.

Dana (CSM): Action items: @Yuki run priming + apply autoscale (EOD); @Marco set throttle & slot-lock (AM); @Arjun run smoke/soak during the window and upload results. I'll host 09:30 PT handoff and include billing + renewals.
